title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
At Perplexity, we're changing how the world finds answers. In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. Millions of people now use Perplexity to transform knowledge into action, and behind all of that sits the technology infrastructure that keeps a fast-moving company running.

We're looking for an IT Engineer who wants to do more than keep the lights on. This is an early, high-impact role where you'll build the systems and automations that let our team move even faster. You won't just respond to tickets or  manual tasks.. You'll figure out how to make them disappear. We give our IT team the same AI tools we build for everyone else, and we expect you to use them.

This role is based hybrid at our San Francisco office.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Use Perplexity's own Computer product to build AI automations, custom skills, and IT workflows that take repetitive work off your plate.

 - Automate the management of users and devices so IT is as hands-off as possible.

 - Enable Self Service and help other departments automate their processes as well.

 - Manage and optimize corporate software systems.

 - Roll out and enforce strong security policies.

 - Lead IT projects across endpoint management, IAM and the IT backend




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 7+ years of hands-on IT systems administration experience.

 - Strong skills in macOS and Google Workspace.

 - Hands-on expertise administering and automating Okta, including securing access with strong auth policies and end‑to‑end user lifecycle automation using Okta Workflows; scripting experience with Bash or Python is highly preferred.

 - Sharp troubleshooting instincts across MDM, Okta and common SaaS applications.

 - A solid grasp of cybersecurity fundamentals, including IAM, RBAC, least privilege and encryption.

 - Experience managing a ticketing system, including ITIL Problem Management and creating and monitoring of SLAs.

 - A track record of leading IT projects from upgrade to rollout with minimum supervision.

 - Clear communication and a genuine interest in automating away busywork.
